en.name: Chicken broth, stock or consommé (commercial)
en.summary: Chicken broth, stock and consommé reach the shop as cans, cartons, concentrates and cubes. Liquid drawn off carcasses, wings and feet is rich in gelatine, so a good one pours loose and golden when warm and is firm enough to spoon when cold. A sealed pack has no shelf figure of its own — read the date the maker printed on it. In the fridge expect around 7 days, falling to 3–4 days after opening, and around 2–3 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: An unopened can or carton is shelf-stable right up to the printed date, so store it cool and dry, away from the cooker and out of direct sunlight, and read that date rather than guessing at one. Cubes and concentrated pastes are the long-life version of the same thing and are what belongs in a cupboard permanently. The moment you pierce the pack, though, you are handling perishable poultry liquid: left standing, it grows the same organisms a roast chicken left out would. The limit at room temperature is 2 hours, or 1 hour once the room is over 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Store at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a clean sealed container — an opened carton tips over and leaks, and stock left sitting in the can picks up a tinny edge. An opened shelf-stable pack gives about 3–4 days, while fresh chilled stock runs about 7 days. Cold stock that has set to a soft jelly under a thin golden disc of chicken fat is a well-made one; the fat disc keeps air off the liquid, so break it only when you want what is under it. Chill it quickly by ladling it into shallow containers instead of pushing a full pot into the fridge, which can take half a day to reach 4 °C and leaves the stock sitting in the 4–60 °C (40–140 °F) range for most of that time. Heat up single portions rather than the whole batch.
en.freezer: Frozen at −18 °C (0 °F) in tubs or flat-frozen bags with headspace left for expansion, chicken stock holds about 2–3 months of good quality and stays safe well beyond that; what expires is the flavour, and the clean roast-poultry aroma goes first. Skim the fat off before freezing anything you mean to keep a while, because it is the fat that turns stale and cardboardy in a freezer, not the gelatine. Small blocks are for deglazing a pan, big flat bags are for soup.
en.thawing: Thaw it in the fridge, or drop the frozen slab into a hot pan and let it melt down. Worktop thawing is not an option here: the outside is sitting in the danger zone while the middle is still solid ice. Reheat to at least 74 °C (165 °F), which any proper boil clears comfortably.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly dented can — discard it without opening
Cloudiness, ropy strands or sliminess in what should be a clear liquid
A sour, fermented or otherwise off smell
Fizzing or bubbles in a sealed container
tips: Decant an opened can into a glass or plastic container immediately.
Label frozen portions with the date and the quantity.
Cool broth fast in a shallow dish, not slowly in a deep pot.
Keep bouillon cubes or concentrate as the long-life standby; the reconstituted broth lasts 3-4 days in the refrigerator.

faq.q: How long does opened chicken broth last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 3–4 days once the carton or can is opened, sealed and kept at 4 °C or below. Fresh refrigerated broth runs about 7 days.
Yes. Portion it with headspace and freeze at −18 °C for about 2–3 months of good quality.

faq.q: How long does an unopened carton of chicken broth keep?
faq.a: There is no fixed timeline — follow the use-by date printed on the package, stored cool and dry.

faq.q: Can you keep broth in the opened can?
faq.a: No. Move it to a sealed glass or plastic container; once air reaches the can the broth takes on a metallic taste.

zh.name: 市售雞高湯
zh.summary: 市售雞高湯有罐頭、利樂包、濃縮液和雞湯塊等形式。用雞骨架、雞翅和雞爪熬出來的湯膠質豐富，熱的時候清澈金黃，冷了會稠到湯匙舀得起來。沒開封的沒有自己的天數，看廠商印在包裝上的日期；冷藏大約 7 天，開封後掉到 3～4 天，冷凍大約 2～3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭或紙盒可以常溫放到廠商標示的日期為止，請收在陰涼乾燥、遠離爐火也曬不到太陽的地方，日期用看的，不要用猜的。雞湯塊和濃縮雞湯醬是同一件事的長效版本，那才是適合長期擺在櫥櫃裡的形式。但只要把包裝戳開，手上拿的就是一鍋會壞的禽肉湯汁：放著不管，它長的菌跟一隻擱在外面的烤雞沒兩樣。室溫上限是 2 小時，室溫超過 32 °C 時只有 1 小時。
zh.fridge: 裝進乾淨的密封容器放 4 °C 以下——紙盒開了口站不穩會漏，留在罐頭裡則會帶出鐵味。常溫包裝開封後約 3～4 天，冷藏販售的新鮮雞高湯約 7 天。冰過如果凝成軟凍、表面浮著一層薄薄的金黃雞油，代表這鍋熬得好；那層油替下面的湯擋住空氣，要用時再戳破。降溫要快：用淺容器分裝，不要把一整鍋直接推進冰箱，那可能要大半天才降到 4 °C，等於讓高湯在 4～60 °C 這段危險溫度帶裡耗掉大半天。加熱也是要多少熱多少，不要整鍋回鍋。
zh.freezer: 分裝進容器或平放的密封袋、留出膨脹空間，放 −18 °C，雞高湯的良好品質約 2～3 個月，安全性則遠不只如此；會到期的是風味，最先跑掉的就是當初吸引你的那股烤雞香。打算放久一點的，先把油撇掉——在冷凍庫裡走味、帶出紙板味的是油脂，不是膠質。小塊的用來嗆鍋，平放的大袋用來煮湯。
zh.thawing: 移到冷藏解凍，或把凍塊丟進熱鍋讓它塌下去化開。這裡不能用室溫解凍：外層已經進入危險溫度帶時，中心還是硬冰。回熱要到 74 °C 以上，只要煮滾就一定超過。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重凹陷——不要開，直接丟掉
本該清澈的湯變濁、出現絲狀物或黏稠感
聞起來發酸、有發酵味或其他異味
密封容器裡冒氣或有氣泡
tips: 開罐後立刻移到玻璃或塑膠容器。
冷凍分裝要標日期和份量。
用淺盤快速降溫，不要用深鍋慢慢放涼。
常備高湯塊或濃縮高湯當長效備品；泡開後的高湯在冰箱可以放 3-4 天。

faq.q: 開封的雞高湯放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 紙盒或罐頭開封後，密封放 4 °C 以下大約 3～4 天。市售冷藏高湯則大約 7 天。
可以。留膨脹空間分裝後放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2～3 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的雞高湯可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有固定天數——以包裝上的有效日期為準，存放在陰涼乾燥處。

faq.q: 可以直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不行。請移到密封的玻璃或塑膠容器；空氣接觸罐身後，高湯會帶金屬味。
